sn22.12:1.1: Evam me sutaṃ || Sāvatthiyaṃ || || Tatra kho || || Rūpam bhikkhave aniccaṃ || pe || || Vedanā aniccā || Sāññā aniccā || Saṅkhārā aniccā || Viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ || Evam passam bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmim pi nibbindati || Vedanāya pi nibbindati || Saññāya pi nibbindati || Saṅkhāresu pi nibbindati || Viññāṇasmim pi nibbindati || nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam iti ñāṇaṃ hoti || || Khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || Sāvatthi || ||
